customManagers.description: Rule 44: the Corepack version every workflow installs; one PR updates them all

packageRules.description: Rule 1: every update automerges once the required CI passes, 0.x and majors included
Rule 11: pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver raises each release as a version update; the digest update of the same commit carries no release date and never passes minimumReleaseAge
Rule 4: lock file maintenance has no release dates to wait on (the package manager's age gate holds new versions back) and is never held back by other PRs
Rule 7: the published package raises the lower bound of its dependency ranges, and an update of them reaches users as a fix
Rule 8: a peer range keeps its lower bound
engines states the Node.js versions the published package supports; it is raised by hand, not by Renovate (the same as a peer range, rule 8)
Rules 10 and 45: vite is installed only as the required peer of vitest (vitest 5 accepts ^6.4.0 || ^7.0.0 || ^8.0.0), so its minor and patch updates move in the same PR as vitest
Rules 10 and 45: a vite major is taken by hand once the vitest peer range admits it; separateMajorMinor gives a group's major its own branch, where vite could arrive alone and outside that range
